description: Entry 1: CalendarEventDetailView body evaluations on the day (per-instance store seam onDetailBodyPass).
Entry 1: prefilled draft computations on the day (seam onPrefilledDraftComputed).
Entry 2 tripwire: ME reflection computed while its view was hidden; must stay 0. Live only when meComputedVisible > 0.
Entry 2 liveness partner: ME reflection computed while visible.

Gestures whose first-delivery lag was quarantined as implausible (epoch-conversion self-announcement).
Durable storage commits of the logRecords slot on the day.
Every calendarEvents commit that reached the disk, checkpoints and delta appends alike.
The subset of slotWritesCalendarEvents that were whole-array checkpoints (gh#235).
Durable storage commits of every other slot on the day.
Auto-windows opened on the day; seeds the window budget across relaunch.
Auto-window openings refused because the daily budget was spent.
Auto-window deadline extensions granted on the day.
Entry 3 criterion arm: tap first-delivery lag histogram, 8 space-separated integer buckets (<=10 <=20 <=40 <=80 <=120 <=320 ms, over, missing; ResidentLagHistogram).
Entry 3 positive-control arm: drag first-delivery lag histogram, same 8 buckets as tapLagBuckets.
gh#181: drag frames that recomputed the drag-invariant memo in CalendarDayLayerView.render.
gh#181: drag frames that reused the memo (healthy shape: rebuilds == distinct structure keys, reuses == frames - rebuilds).

Auto-window: logRecords slot commits inside the window.
Auto-window: calendarEvents slot commits inside the window.

Auto-window: deadline extensions this window took.
Auto-window: signals coalesced after the per-window cap was reached.
Auto-window: a gesture began inside the window and had not seen its commit by close (R-F8 truncation honesty).
Auto-window: the window closed because the app resigned active.
